metadata.description: Curated central government agricultural schemes. Always confirm current eligibility and deadlines on the official portal linked in each record.
metadata.important_note: Listing here does not mean a farmer is approved or guaranteed eligible. Final eligibility is decided by the implementing department.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Direct income support to eligible landholding farmer families, paid in instalments through direct benefit transfer.
schemes.description_hi: पात्र भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को सीधे बैंक खाते में किस्तों में आय सहायता।
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Landholding farmer family with cultivable land in the farmer's name as per land records
Valid Aadhaar and an active bank account linked with Aadhaar
Certain categories such as institutional landholders, income-tax payers and government employees are excluded under the scheme rules
benefits: Income support of ₹6,000 per year, normally paid in three equal instalments
Direct benefit transfer to the eligible farmer's bank account
application_procedure: Open the official PM-KISAN portal and choose the new farmer registration option
Complete Aadhaar or land-record based verification as prompted
Submit land and bank details and track the application status on the portal
Use the official help desk or Common Service Centre if assistance is needed

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Crop insurance scheme that provides financial support when notified crops are damaged by covered natural risks.
schemes.description_hi: अधिसूचित फसलों को प्राकृतिक जोखिमों से नुकसान होने पर वित्तीय सहायता देने वाली फसल बीमा योजना।
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Farmers growing a crop notified for insurance in their area during the relevant season
Both loanee and non-loanee farmers can apply, subject to scheme rules
Enrolment must be completed within the notified cut-off date for the season
benefits: Insurance cover for notified crop losses from covered natural risks
Farmer premium share is subsidised by the government as per the scheme
Claims are assessed through the scheme's crop-loss assessment process
required_documents: Sowing certificate or crop declaration as required
Previous crop insurance details where applicable
application_procedure: Check whether your crop and area are notified for the current season
Apply through the official PMFBY portal, your bank, insurance intermediary or a Common Service Centre
Pay the applicable farmer premium and keep the receipt
Retain the application acknowledgement for claim follow-up

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Short-term credit facility for crop production and related needs, offered through banks with interest subvention where applicable.
schemes.description_hi: फसल उत्पादन और संबंधित जरूरतों के लिए बैंकों के माध्यम से अल्पकालिक ऋण सुविधा, जहां लागू हो वहां ब्याज सहायता के साथ।
schemes.department: Department of Financial Services and partner banks; NABARD guidance
eligibility: Farmers with cultivable land, including owner-cultivators
Tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers subject to bank and state rules
Self-help groups and joint liability groups may be covered as per bank policy
benefits: Working capital for crop production and allied activities
Concessional interest and prompt-repayment incentive as per applicable government and RBI policy
Credit limit is assessed by the lending bank
required_documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar or other accepted ID)
Crop plan and bank account details
application_procedure: Visit your bank branch or use the bank's KCC application channel
Complete the KCC application and submit land and identity documents
The bank assesses the credit limit and eligibility
Use the sanctioned credit only for the permitted agricultural purposes

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Provides soil testing and a soil health card with nutrient status and crop-wise fertiliser recommendations.
schemes.description_hi: मिट्टी परीक्षण और पोषक तत्वों की स्थिति तथा फसल-वार उर्वरक सिफारिशों वाला मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड।
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: All farmers with cultivable land can request soil testing through the state agriculture department
Sampling cycles and local procedures are managed by the state government
benefits: Soil test results for key parameters
Crop-wise nutrient and fertiliser recommendations
Helps avoid unnecessary fertiliser expenditure
application_procedure: Contact the local Krishi Vigyan Kendra, agriculture office or soil testing laboratory
Collect soil samples as instructed by the local agriculture department
Submit the sample with plot details and contact information
Use the soil health card recommendations with expert guidance

schemes.name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
schemes.description: Online platform connecting farmers and traders to participating mandis for transparent agricultural trade.
schemes.description_hi: किसानों और व्यापारियों को भाग लेने वाली मंडियों से जोड़ने वाला पारदर्शी ऑनलाइन कृषि व्यापार मंच।
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Farmers trading in an e-NAM-enabled mandi
Registration and onboarding are completed through the participating mandi or platform
FPOs and farmer groups may also participate subject to platform rules
benefits: Access to participating mandis and online price discovery
Transparent lot-based trading records
Potential access to a wider buyer network where available
application_procedure: Check whether your local mandi is integrated with e-NAM
Register as a farmer through the e-NAM portal, mobile app or mandi help desk
Complete verification with the local mandi
Bring produce to the mandi and follow local e-NAM lot and payment procedures

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM Scheme
schemes.description: Promotes solar pumps and solar power for agriculture, reducing dependence on diesel and grid power.
schemes.description_hi: कृषि के लिए सोलर पंप और सोलर ऊर्जा को बढ़ावा देती योजना, जिससे डीजल और ग्रिड बिजली पर निर्भरता कम होती है।
schemes.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India
eligibility: Individual farmers, cooperatives, FPOs, panchayats and water user associations as per the applicable component
Availability of land and technical feasibility of the solar pump or solar plant
State-specific implementation guidelines and selection processes apply
benefits: Support for solar irrigation pumps and related solar systems
Reduced diesel and electricity costs over the system life
Grid-connected farmers may be able to sell surplus solar power under applicable state rules
required_documents: Land documents for the proposed site
application_procedure: Check your state's PM-KUSUM implementation agency and current application window
Apply through the designated state portal or agency as instructed
Complete technical and land feasibility verification
Pay the farmer share, if any, after selection and follow installation guidelines

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
schemes.description: Financing facility for post-harvest and community farming infrastructure, with interest subvention and credit guarantee support.
schemes.description_hi: फसल के बाद की और सामुदायिक कृषि अवसंरचना के लिए वित्तपोषण सुविधा, ब्याज सहायता और ऋण गारंटी सहायता के साथ।
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, cooperatives, agri-entrepreneurs, startups and other eligible beneficiaries
Project must be a viable post-harvest or community farming asset as defined under the scheme
Loan appraisal and approval are done by the participating lending institution
benefits: Interest subvention on eligible loans as per scheme guidelines
Credit guarantee coverage for eligible borrowers
Support for storage, processing, logistics and community farming assets
required_documents: Bank and financial statements as requested by the lender
Registration documents for FPOs, cooperatives or companies
application_procedure: Prepare a project proposal for the proposed agricultural infrastructure
Apply through the AIF portal and select a participating lending institution
Complete bank appraisal and submit required documents
After approval, follow the loan and asset-creation conditions

schemes.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
schemes.description: Supports horticulture development including nurseries, protected cultivation, post-harvest management and market linkages.
schemes.description_hi: नर्सरी, संरक्षित खेती, फसल के बाद प्रबंधन और बाजार संपर्क सहित बागवानी विकास को सहायता।
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Farmers and farmer groups taking up eligible horticulture activities
State horticulture department norms and project approval apply
Some components may have specific area, unit-size or beneficiary conditions
benefits: Assistance for eligible horticulture inputs and infrastructure as per norms
Support for protected cultivation, nurseries and post-harvest units
Training and demonstration support through state agencies
required_documents: Project or component application as required by the state
application_procedure: Contact the district horticulture office to confirm current components and subsidy norms
Submit the prescribed application with land and project details
Complete technical verification and approval
Implement the approved activity and claim assistance as instructed

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
schemes.description: Voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing a monthly pension after age 60.
schemes.description_hi: लघु और सीमांत किसानों के लिए स्वैच्छिक पेंशन योजना, जिसमें 60 वर्ष के बाद मासिक पेंशन मिलती है।
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare with Life Insurance Corporation of India
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land up to 2 hectares
Entry age between 18 and 40 years
Aadhaar, bank account and land records are required
Applicants should not be covered under another statutory pension scheme in the specified manner
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining age 60, subject to scheme conditions
Government co-contribution for eligible subscribers
Family pension benefit as per scheme rules
application_procedure: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre or use the official PM-KMY enrolment channel
Complete Aadhaar and land-record verification
Choose the contribution option and submit the auto-debit mandate
Track contributions and enrolment status through the official portal

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.description: Supports organic farming through farmer clusters, participatory guarantee certification and training.
schemes.description_hi: किसान समूहों, सहभागी गारंटी प्रमाणन और प्रशिक्षण के माध्यम से जैविक खेती को सहायता।
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibility: Farmer groups and clusters willing to adopt organic farming practices
Cluster size and state implementation conditions must be met
Participation in training and certification processes is required
benefits: Support for organic inputs, certification and cluster activities as per norms
Training and handholding for organic farming
Support for marketing and certification where applicable
application_procedure: Contact the district agriculture office or state organic farming cell
Form or join an eligible farmer cluster as per local guidelines
Submit the prescribed application and participate in training
Follow the organic package of practices and certification requirements
